command: for port in 3005 3017; do echo "Port $port:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:$port/ 2>&1; echo; done

# Try with cookie jar to handle auth
curl -sL -c /tmp/cal_cookies -b /tmp/cal_cookies "http://localhost:3017/?_autologin=1" | head -200

# Check the API endpoints
curl -sL -c /tmp/cal_cookies -b /tmp/cal_cookies "http://localhost:3017/api/events" 2>&1 | head -200

# Today is Aug 25 (Mon). Next Thursday is Aug 28. Get events for that day.
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies "http://localhost:3017/api/events?start=2025-08-28T00:00:00&end=2025-08-28T23:59:59" | python3 -m json.tool

# Try broader date range to find all events
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies "http://localhost:3017/api/events?start=2025-08-25T00:00:00&end=2025-09-01T23:59:59" | python3 -m json.tool

# Try autologin first, then events
curl -s -c /tmp/cal2 -b /tmp/cal2 -L "http://localhost:3017/?_autologin=1" > /dev/null
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events?start=2025-08-25T00:00:00&end=2025-09-01T23:59:59" | python3 -m json.tool

# Try different API paths
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events" 2>&1
echo "---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/calendars" 2>&1
echo "---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/users" 2>&1
echo "---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/me" 2>&1

# Try with 2026 dates - the next Thursday from Aug 25, 2026 is Aug 27, 2026
# Wait, Aug 25, 2026 - what day is that?
python3 -c "import datetime; d = datetime.date(2026, 8, 25); print(d.strftime('%A'))"

# Next Thursday is Aug 27, 2026
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events?start=2026-08-27T00:00:00&end=2026-08-27T23:59:59" | python3 -m json.tool

# Check for attendees on these events
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766" 2>&1 | python3 -m json.tool
echo "==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events/765" 2>&1 | python3 -m json.tool
echo "==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events/764" 2>&1 | python3 -m json.tool

# Check if there's an attendees endpoint
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766/attendees" 2>&1 | head -200
echo "==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events/765/attendees" 2>&1 | head -200
echo "==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal2 "http://localhost:3017/api/events/764/attendees" 2>&1 | head -200
